source: reference/design/benchmark.md in the 5050cloud repository, from the demo pipeline's make bench
vm: Ubuntu 24.04, 8 vCPU (4 physical cores, 2 threads each, AMD EPYC), 32 GB RAM, one host.
app: apps/node-cpu: each request counts the primes below LIMIT on Node's main thread
load: oha 1.16.0 on the same VM through the HTTPS proxy, 32 connections, 15 s warm-up, median of 3 runs of 30 s
why: The gain is about the number of physical cores. On an earlier 2 vCPU VM whose two vCPUs were two threads of one core, the same test gained only 1.03x to 1.07x, because both processes shared one core's divider.
